# Preview credits

<!-- Generated by `swift run --package-path scripts/themes mactoy-themes credits themes/catalog.json themes/previews/CREDITS.md`. Don't edit by hand. -->

Each picture in this folder is a screenshot of a boot menu theme running in Ventoy. A theme's picture is named for its `id` in [`catalog.json`](../catalog.json). The artwork in a screenshot belongs to the theme's author and is shown under the theme's license.
